Hi Sara / Alan —

Thanks for the time today — great to learn more about Acme's roadmap and the specific ML/infra constraints you mentioned. Quick recap and proposed next step:

Recap (short):
- Primary use case: real-time clinical note summarization for provider workflows (low-latency, PII-sensitive).
- Expected QPS: bursty (10-50 req/s) with median seq length ~512 tokens; peak sessions up to 2k tokens.
- Key concerns: on-prem/private deployment, audit logs, and predictable tail latency.

Next step: 60-90 minute technical deep dive with our ML + infra leads to walk through integration patterns, performance expectations, and deployment options (Private vs Dedicated). Suggested agenda attached.

Proposed windows (PT):
- Tue Mar 3: 10:00-11:30 or 14:00-15:30
- Wed Mar 4: 10:00-11:30 (preferred for our infra team)
- Thu Mar 5: 09:00-10:30

Could you confirm who from your side will join (SRE, Data Engineering, Security) and which window works best? Also please share any network/firewall docs or internal PKI requirements ahead of time if you have them.

Attaching: redwood-td-agenda.pdf (draft).

Thanks —

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0172
